name: Archmage Alturus
summary: Archmage Alturus is a senior Kirin Tor investigator stationed outside the haunting towers of Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. Representing the Violet Eye, he monitors the volatile magical ley-lines converging upon the former seat of the Guardian Medivh. Travelers seeking to uncover the dark secrets of the tower must first consult his careful observations.

sections.title: Watcher of the Tower
sections.body: While most scholars of Dalaran avoid the desolate ravines of Deadwind Pass, Archmage Alturus remains encamped in the shadow of Karazhan. Representing the secretive Violet Eye, Alturus is tasked by his peers with measuring the arcane disturbances and restless spirits haunting the surrounding ruins. He understands better than most that Karazhan sits directly atop a massive nexus where Azeroth's magical ley-lines converge, making its residual corruption a threat to the entire world.

sections.title: Studies in the Cellar
sections.body: Alturus's vigilance extends beyond passive observation. With access to a secluded sanctum hidden near the Master's Cellar, he tirelessly inspects the grounds for traces of Medivh's lingering sorcery and otherworldly intruders. He often enlists capable adventurers to recover relics, chart ghostly disturbances, and piece together Medivh's lost writings, desperate to prevent the tower's unbridled power from slipping into worse hands.

faq.answer: Archmage Alturus is a high-ranking human mage of Dalaran and an operative of the Violet Eye. He is stationed in Deadwind Pass just outside the gates of Karazhan to study and contain the bizarre magical phenomena emanating from the citadel.

faq.q: Why is Alturus standing outside Karazhan?
faq.answer: He is monitoring the arcane instability of Karazhan. Because the tower sits directly over a critical convergence of Azeroth's subterranean ley-lines, any magical catastrophe within could have catastrophic consequences for the rest of the continent.

The Violet Eye is a secretive sect of the Kirin Tor dedicated exclusively to watching Karazhan and its master, Medivh. Even after Medivh's fall, they maintain their vigil around the tower to ensure its dark powers remain contained.
Alturus coordinates with fellow Kirin Tor researchers sent to Deadwind Pass, including Archmage Leryda, and reports back to senior authorities in Dalaran such as Archmage Cedric.

angles.text: For practitioners of the arcane, Alturus represents the Kirin Tor's enduring vigil over Medivh's unchecked ambition and the volatile nexus beneath Karazhan.
Though operating under Dalaran's neutral scholarly banner, Alturus provides human and Alliance travelers with vital insight into the growing perils of southern Deadwind Pass.
